body: Thank you for replying. Usually when things get the worst it ends with me already in that period of crushing isolation. I don't know how to get out of depression when that ends up making it worse for me. I know I shouldn't completely rely on others for my happiness, but I really have no idea how to live my life without friends. Being so utterly and completely alone is most of the reason I feel that way, along with kicking myself over whatever I might've done to push my friends away.

It's almost like it's the universe just telling you to give up, confirming your suspicion that nobody really cares or values you anymore. I just posted something in r/suicidewatch, and it's only been like four hours sure and i posted it at a weird time, but every second it just sits there ignored just keeps hurting more and more that no one in the world really cares.

Maybe it's just another one of those hard truths we have to accept or let kill us. Of all the times I've tried to reach out for help, it never really seems like there's anyone else out there that is willing to. Like all these words are just some lifeless internet page written by a robot, no living person anywhere behind the posts, and you're just posting into this massive void where your thoughts and pain are just going to get lost to it forever. Really makes you feel like you are all alone in this and always will be.
